sources.summary: Asca Studio and Relief Gallery joined forces to create the interiors of the Ómós guesthouse outside Abbeyleix, Ireland, which was converted from a ruin into a welcoming space filled with tactile materials. The 16-room guesthouse is located in a formerly dilapidated Victorian house that was renovated by local studio Ryan W Kennihan Architects.
